findings: Tracked-path bootstrap rejection on the current published HEAD 3a6490ff391453535168491b3f8d26adf9e20938 occurs at scripts/ci/canonical_shell_wall_runner.py:1171-1200 because the live expected-head commit object lacks the five required P1 trailers.

Runtime host/self-test paths independently fail at scripts/ci/canonical_shell_wall_runner.py:12133-12159 because _verify_commit_trailers reads and compares P1 trailers on the live expected_head commit object; current HEAD still carries the exact reviewed runner/test blobs from 8c46135c861a468dea316cf9fd7d6c6bb15bddac, so the failure is commit-object/trailer drift, not blob drift.

Stage authority currently forces launcher.authority_commit_oid == expected_head at scripts/ci/canonical_shell_wall_runner.py:482-499, so an ordinary descendant cannot be authenticated even if trailer verification is moved to a reviewed authority ancestor.

Current code and the core P1 authority text both enforce reviewed P1 commit == live HEAD == CLI --expected-head. Later provenance schema fields and regression-ledger language imply descendant continuity, but that model was never implemented or fully re-authorized. No currently supported ordinary-descendant invocation was found.

Linked worktrees are a separate blocker: .git must be a directory identity-matched to the repository and commondir/config.worktree are forbidden, so the current Codex worktree would fail repository_identity_mismatch even after the exit-65 trailer issue is addressed unless execution moves to a full non-worktree checkout or separate worktree support is authorized.
